overview: The City Council elected Laurel Siegel as the new City Clerk, approved critical fiscal year 2026 year-end budget transfers, and authorized land easements for the Main Street Corridor safety project. The Council also approved various school capital improvements while tabling funding for a national police chief search.

items.title: Meeting Records and Reports
items.summary: Approved the records of the June 24, 2026, meeting and the report of the Committee of the Whole from June 23, 2026, while tabling the records of June 23, 2026.

items.title: Report of the Committee of the Whole on Medford Arts Council
items.summary: Approved the report discussing funding and the city's relationship with the Medford Arts Council and Arts Collaborative Medford.

items.title: Election of Laurel Siegel as City Clerk
items.summary: Approved the election of Laurel Siegel as City Clerk for a three-year term effective August 10, 2026.

items.title: Resolution on MBTA Bus Redesign Meetings
items.summary: Approved a resolution to inform residents of upcoming MBTA meetings, amended to request that the administration use all available communication methods to reach affected residents.

items.title: Resolution to Investigate Auto-Pay for City Bills
items.summary: Tabled a request to evaluate auto-pay feasibility for taxes and utilities to allow the petitioner to research if the functionality already exists within current systems.

items.title: Medford Commission for Persons with Disabilities Ordinance Update
items.summary: Approved for first reading an updated ordinance to modernize terminology and clarify the commission's role according to state law.

items.title: Capital and General Stabilization Fund Appropriations
items.summary: Approved funding for school facility improvements and an IT server replacement, while tabling a $35,000 request for a police chief recruitment firm pending state approval of civil service changes.

items.title: Personnel Ordinance Amendments for Assistant Network Administrator and Tree Warden
items.summary: Ordained amendments to the personnel ordinance regarding the Assistant Network Administrator and Tree Warden positions following their third readings.

items.title: Hormel Stadium Commission Appointment
items.summary: Confirmed the appointment of Ryan O’Keefe to the Hormel Stadium Commission.

items.title: FY 2026 Year-End Transfers
items.summary: Approved approximately $2 million in budget transfers to cover departmental deficits, despite significant councilor frustration regarding the timing of the request and excessive fire department overtime costs.

items.title: Litigation Settlements
items.summary: Approved three settlements totaling $10,649.26 for property damage claims involving city snowplows.

items.title: Main Street Corridor Easements and Land Takings
items.summary: Approved orders for the alteration of the layout of Main Street and the taking of temporary and permanent easements to facilitate a MassDOT safety project.

items.title: Oak Grove Cemetery Building Study
items.summary: Approved $24,550 for a conceptual design and cost estimate for a new operations building at Oak Grove Cemetery.
